high_level_description: The image depicts a scene set in a modern, possibly futuristic room with a large window offering a view of an urban landscape at night. The room has a sleek, minimalist design with a dark floor and walls that reflect the light from the window. In the center of the room is a round table with various objects on it. On the left side of the table, there is a chessboard with pieces arranged on it, suggesting a game in progress or recently played. Next to the chessboard, there are several dominoes scattered on the table.
